role_description: The main Claude Code agent loop that planned, built and exported every version and spawned the subagents.
Patch writers, the score composer and the v13 builder: subagents that write code the main agent then reviews and applies.
Senior-editor critic: watches one version and scores it on ten categories. The primary quality score.
Blind A/B judge: compares two versions section by section on a fixed rubric without knowing which is newer.
Crowd reactions: the mean-commenter and first-time-viewer critiques of one version.
Fact-check, tool research and report triage.

Support agents that are not builders, evaluators or researchers: thumbnails, dashboards, tool installs and vetting, reaction corpora, the project audit and this analytics work. Not part of the trailer edit.
